name: Skills list renders the seeded skills and previews one
description: Loads /skills, confirms a seeded skill card (uncovered-branch-gate) renders, and clicks it to reveal the side preview with its body. Exercises the skills list route, its API fetch, and the card→preview selection. Read-only against seeded data (no model call, no write). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB — the built-in skills are inserted by server/src/db/seed.ts.

steps.label: preview pane prompts for a selection
the skill body renders in the preview
